Signal integrity modeling/testing includes insertion loss, Dk/Df, roughness, and impedance [7].

RefClk and PLL jitter performance is associated with phase noise analyzers and signal generators [4].

ADC/DAC frontend performance is associated with spectrum analyzers and signal generators [4].
review.reason: Most individual statements are directly supported as general wireless-certification or general SI/PI/PCB capabilities, but the cited passages do not clearly establish that the SerDes/PCB/PDN/ADC-DAC items are the most important signal-integrity capabilities specifically for wireless communication applications. The answer is nevertheless a reasonable evidence-based list rather than a fabricated ranking, with useful wireless context and no major contradiction.
